usage: 蚊 (man1) is used as a noun to refer to the insect mosquito.
You can use 蚊 in singular and plural contexts, for example, 一隻蚊 (one mosquito) or 好多野蚊 (many mosquitoes).
蚊 often appears in everyday conversation when talking about insects or being bitten during summer or in warm places.
It can be used in sentences with verbs like 'bite' (咬 ngo5) or 'kill' (殺 saat3) to describe actions involving mosquitoes.
蚊 can also be part of compound words or idiomatic expressions related to insects or irritation.
